arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قُل أوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ استَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الجِنِّ فَقالوا إِنّا سَمِعنا قُرءانًا عَجَبًا
transliteration: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban
translation: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an

arabic: يَهدى إِلَى الرُّشدِ فَـٔامَنّا بِهِ وَلَن نُشرِكَ بِرَبِّنا أَحَدًا
transliteration: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan
translation: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord

arabic: وَأَنَّهُ تَعٰلىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنا مَا اتَّخَذَ صٰحِبَةً وَلا وَلَدًا
transliteration: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan
translation: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son

arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كانَ يَقولُ سَفيهُنا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا
transliteration: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan
translation: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie

arabic: وَأَنّا ظَنَنّا أَن لَن تَقولَ الإِنسُ وَالجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
transliteration: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban
translation: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah

arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كانَ رِجالٌ مِنَ الإِنسِ يَعوذونَ بِرِجالٍ مِنَ الجِنِّ فَزادوهُم رَهَقًا
transliteration: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan
translation: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah

arabic: وَأَنَّهُم ظَنّوا كَما ظَنَنتُم أَن لَن يَبعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا
transliteration: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan
translation: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)

arabic: وَأَنّا لَمَسنَا السَّماءَ فَوَجَدنٰها مُلِئَت حَرَسًا شَديدًا وَشُهُبًا
transliteration: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban
translation: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors

arabic: وَأَنّا كُنّا نَقعُدُ مِنها مَقٰعِدَ لِلسَّمعِ فَمَن يَستَمِعِ الءانَ يَجِد لَهُ شِهابًا رَصَدًا
transliteration: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan
translation: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him

arabic: وَأَنّا لا نَدرى أَشَرٌّ أُريدَ بِمَن فِى الأَرضِ أَم أَرادَ بِهِم رَبُّهُم رَشَدًا
transliteration: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan
translation: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them

arabic: وَأَنّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحونَ وَمِنّا دونَ ذٰلِكَ كُنّا طَرائِقَ قِدَدًا
transliteration: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan
translation: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules

arabic: وَأَنّا ظَنَنّا أَن لَن نُعجِزَ اللَّهَ فِى الأَرضِ وَلَن نُعجِزَهُ هَرَبًا
transliteration: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban
translation: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight

arabic: وَأَنّا لَمّا سَمِعنَا الهُدىٰ ءامَنّا بِهِ فَمَن يُؤمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلا يَخافُ بَخسًا وَلا رَهَقًا
transliteration: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan
translation: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression

arabic: وَأَنّا مِنَّا المُسلِمونَ وَمِنَّا القٰسِطونَ فَمَن أَسلَمَ فَأُولٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan
translation: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully

arabic: وَأَمَّا القٰسِطونَ فَكانوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
transliteration: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban
translation: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell

arabic: وَأَلَّوِ استَقٰموا عَلَى الطَّريقَةِ لَأَسقَينٰهُم ماءً غَدَقًا
transliteration: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan
translation: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

arabic: لِنَفتِنَهُم فيهِ وَمَن يُعرِض عَن ذِكرِ رَبِّهِ يَسلُكهُ عَذابًا صَعَدًا
transliteration: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan
translation: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment

arabic: وَأَنَّ المَسٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلا تَدعوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا
transliteration: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan
translation: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah

arabic: وَأَنَّهُ لَمّا قامَ عَبدُ اللَّهِ يَدعوهُ كادوا يَكونونَ عَلَيهِ لِبَدًا
transliteration: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan
translation: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling

arabic: قُل إِنَّما أَدعوا رَبّى وَلا أُشرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا
transliteration: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan
translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner

arabic: قُل إِنّى لا أَملِكُ لَكُم ضَرًّا وَلا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan
translation: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you

arabic: قُل إِنّى لَن يُجيرَنى مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَن أَجِدَ مِن دونِهِ مُلتَحَدًا
transliteration: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan
translation: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him

arabic: إِلّا بَلٰغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهِ وَمَن يَعصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدينَ فيها أَبَدًا
transliteration: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan
translation: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever

arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا رَأَوا ما يوعَدونَ فَسَيَعلَمونَ مَن أَضعَفُ ناصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
transliteration: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan
translation: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude

arabic: قُل إِن أَدرى أَقَريبٌ ما توعَدونَ أَم يَجعَلُ لَهُ رَبّى أَمَدًا
transliteration: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan
translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it

arabic: عٰلِمُ الغَيبِ فَلا يُظهِرُ عَلىٰ غَيبِهِ أَحَدًا
transliteration: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan
translation: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret

arabic: إِلّا مَنِ ارتَضىٰ مِن رَسولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسلُكُ مِن بَينِ يَدَيهِ وَمِن خَلفِهِ رَصَدًا
transliteration: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan
translation: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him

arabic: لِيَعلَمَ أَن قَد أَبلَغوا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِم وَأَحاطَ بِما لَدَيهِم وَأَحصىٰ كُلَّ شَيءٍ عَدَدًا
transliteration: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan
translation: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things
